You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 37dde06377a1daa9d86150ed431b89c49c699e10 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Brian Raney <braney@soe.ucsc.edu>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2020 14:45:09 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] fix a problem introduced by f87fbb58.   Track hub tracks are
 in a group called after the hub name (eg hub_#).  Refs #25050

---
 src/hg/lib/cartTrackDb.c | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/hg/lib/cartTrackDb.c b/src/hg/lib/cartTrackDb.c
index ed6e5d2b3fb..702d4d839ad 100644
--- a/src/hg/lib/cartTrackDb.c
+++ b/src/hg/lib/cartTrackDb.c
@@ -90,7 +90,8 @@ if (!trackHubDatabase(db))
         hashAdd(allGroups, group->name, group);
     for (track = trackList; track != NULL; track = track->next)
         {
-        if (!hashLookup(allGroups, track->grp))
+        /* If track isn't in a track up, and has a group we don't know about, change it to one we do. */
+        if (!startsWith("hub_", track->grp) && !hashLookup(allGroups, track->grp))
             {
             fprintf(stderr, "Track %s has group %s, which isn't in grp table\n",
                     track->table, track->grp);
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the system not recognizing track groups that were prefixed with "hub_". The previous implementation failed to account for track groups associated with track hubs, leading to an error when tracks belonging to these groups were processed. The patch corrects this by ensuring that tracks with groups starting with "hub_" are not incorrectly flagged as unknown groups, thus preventing the error message from being triggered for valid track groups associated with hubs.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the system not recognizing track groups that were prefixed with "hub_". The previous implementation failed to account for track groups associated with track hubs, leading to an error when tracks belonging to these groups were processed. The patch corrects this by ensuring that tracks with groups starting with "hub_" are not incorrectly flagged as unknown groups, thus preventing the error message from being triggered for valid track groups associated with hubs.
